package registration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	dexec "github.com/viant/datly/exec"
	"github.com/viant/datly/spec"
	"github.com/viant/datly/standalone"
	"github.com/viant/datly/standalone/config"
	fixture "github.com/viant/datly/transcribe/testdata/handleronly"
	upstream "github.com/viant/mcp"
	"github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/authorization"
	oauthmeta "github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/oauth2/meta"
	"github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/schema"
	mcpclient "github.com/viant/mcp/client"
	"github.com/viant/x"
)

func TestGeneratedHandlerRuntime(t *testing.T) {
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, eager := range []bool{false, true} {
		for _, registered := range []bool{false, true} {
			name := "indexed"
			if eager {
				name = "eager"
			}
			if registered {
				name += "/registry"
			} else {
				name += "/holder"
			}
			t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
				defer cancel()
				exports := x.NewRegistry()
				before := fixture.Constructions.Load()
				if registered {
					require.NoError(t, RegisterConvertFactories(exports))
				}
				require.Equal(t, before, fixture.Constructions.Load(), "registration must not invoke factory")
				cfg := &config.Config{BaseDir: filepath.Dir(cwd), GoBootstrap: &config.Packages{Packages: []string{"github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/registration"}, EagerComponents: eager}, Endpoint: config.Endpoint{Address: "127.0.0.1:0"}, MCP: &config.MCP{Address: "127.0.0.1:0"}}
				cfg.MCP.Authorization = &authorization.Policy{Tools: map[string]*authorization.Authorization{"Convert": {ProtectedResourceMetadata: &oauthmeta.ProtectedResourceMetadata{Resource: "https://test.invalid/convert"}}}}
				server, err := standalone.New(ctx, standalone.Options{Config: cfg, Registry: exports, Holders: []any{ConvertDatly}})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				done := make(chan error, 1)
				go func() { done <- server.Serve(ctx, io.Discard) }()
				t.Cleanup(func() {
					cancel()
					require.NoError(t, server.Shutdown(context.Background()))
					require.NoError(t, <-done)
				})
				addresses, err := server.WaitReady(ctx)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Len(t, addresses, 2)
				for _, tc := range []struct {
					token, inclusion string
					code             int
				}{{"", "one", 401}, {"allowed", "fail", 400}, {"allowed", "one", 200}} {
					body := `{"inclusion":"` + tc.inclusion + `","exclusion":"two"}`
					request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/convert?debug=true", strings.NewReader(body))
					request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
					request.Header.Set("Authorization", tc.token)
					response := httptest.NewRecorder()
					server.ServeHTTP(response, request)
					require.Equal(t, tc.code, response.Code, response.Body.String())
					if tc.code == 200 {
						require.JSONEq(t, `{"converted":"one:two:debug"}`, response.Body.String())
					}
				}
				value, err := server.InvokeComponent(ctx, dexec.ComponentRequest{Target: dexec.ComponentTarget{Component: spec.Key{Kind: spec.KindComponent, Scope: "github.com/viant/datly/handlerfixture/registration", Name: "Convert"}, Route: spec.RouteRef{Method: "POST", Path: "/convert"}}, Input: &fixture.Input{Token: "allowed", Inclusion: "child", Exclusion: "typed"}})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				data, err := json.Marshal(value)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.JSONEq(t, `{"converted":"child:typed"}`, string(data))
				client, err := upstream.NewClientWithContext(ctx, nil, &upstream.ClientOptions{Name: "test", Version: "1", ProtocolVersion: schema.LatestProtocolVersion, Transport: upstream.ClientTransport{Type: "streamable", ClientTransportHTTP: upstream.ClientTransportHTTP{URL: "http://" + addresses[1] + "/mcp"}}})
				require.NoError(t, err)
				defer client.Close()
				list, err := client.ListTools(ctx, nil)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				data, err = json.Marshal(list)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Contains(t, string(data), "Convert")
				result, err := client.CallTool(ctx, &schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: "Convert", Arguments: map[string]any{"Inclusion": "mcp", "Exclusion": "typed", "Debug": true}}, mcpclient.WithAuthToken("allowed"))
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.False(t, result.IsError != nil && *result.IsError, "%+v", result)
				data, err = json.Marshal(result.StructuredContent)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.JSONEq(t, `{"converted":"mcp:typed:debug"}`, string(data))
				result, err = client.CallTool(ctx, &schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: "Convert", Arguments: map[string]any{"Exclusion": "typed"}}, mcpclient.WithAuthToken("allowed"))
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.False(t, result.IsError != nil && *result.IsError)
				data, err = json.Marshal(result.StructuredContent)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.JSONEq(t, `{"converted":"default:typed"}`, string(data), "handwritten input initialization is retained")
				for _, tc := range []struct{ token, inclusion string }{{"denied", "one"}, {"allowed", "fail"}} {
					result, err = client.CallTool(ctx, &schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: "Convert", Arguments: map[string]any{"Inclusion": tc.inclusion}}, mcpclient.WithAuthToken(tc.token))
					require.NoError(t, err)
					require.True(t, result.IsError != nil && *result.IsError)
				}
				require.Greater(t, fixture.Constructions.Load(), before)
			})
		}
	}
}
